The group attempts to save the Earth from an incoming asteroid.

Glomgold forms his own team made up of all of Scrooge's greatest villains to defeat Scrooge's family once and for all.
Gramma tells Cricket and Tilly that there's treasure buried on their property; Cricket adds his own doodles to Gloria's abstract paintings.

Led by a more powerful Ezra, the rebels break an old friend out of prison to help acquire ships for the fleet, but Kanan discovers that Ezra's new skills come from a dark place.
When Ezra's mission to steal ships goes awry due to his reckless leadership, Kanan returns to help the Ghost crew; Thrawn emerges as a new threat.
Maul takes the crew of the Ghost hostage and Ezra and Kanan must recover an ancient Sith artifact to save them.
On a salvage mission led by Captain Rex, a unit of old battle droids captures the Ghost crew, determined to fight one last battle to end the Clone Wars.
Seeking information on a new Imperial weapon, Ezra and Kanan infiltrate the Imperial factory on Lothal, but must trust an unlikely ally to escape a lockdown.
Haunted by visions of Maul, Ezra must journey across the galaxy to engage in a strange ritual to sever his connection with Maul.
The crew returns to Geonosis in search of a missing rebel team sent to investigate suspicious activity there, and are surprised by what they find.
After finding a missing rebel team member, the Ghost crew discovers another surprise on Geonosis, and work to conceal it from Imperial forces.
To help recruit her people to join the rebels, Sabine reluctantly agrees to learn to wield an ancient Mandalorian weapon but finds the challenge more difficult than expected.
Hoping to get her family to help the rebels, Sabine returns home with Kanan and Ezra, and finds herself embroiled in her family's power struggle for Mandalore.
Fearing that the Empire will soon discover the identity of a rebel spy, the Rebels launch a plan to rescue him before his capture.
When a routine refueling mission goes wrong, the Ghost crew find themselves transporting an important rebel leader across the galaxy, pursued by Imperial warships.
Chopper and AP-5 team up to infiltrate an Imperial station to steal needed codes, but an Imperial specialist turns the droids against the crew to cause chaos.
Reacting to a vision of Maul, Ezra defies Hera and Kanan to travel to a remote planet in hopes of stopping the former Sith lord from carrying out his plans.
In the final preparations for Phoenix Squadron's attack on Lothal, Grand Admiral Thrawn discovers their location and disrupts their plans.
Trapped on Atollon with the rebel base under siege, Hera and Kanan fight to keep the squadron alive, as Ezra attempts to rally help from an unexpected source.
A rebel mission led by a more powerful Ezra goes awry; Kanan returns to help the Ghost crew; Grand Admiral Thrawn emerges as a new threat.
X-wing pilot Kazuda Xiono is recruited for the Resistance, but finds himself in over his head when Poe Dameron assigns him to a remote fueling station to spy on the First Order.

Kaz and BB-8 uncover information on an imminent pirate attack and must find a way to stop it.
Kaz befriends a sky racer named Rucklin who pressures him to take some rare and dangerous hyperfuel hidden in Yeager's office.
The First Order arrives at the platform for mysterious reasons, and Kaz and BB-8 are determined to sneak into the tower to find out what they want.
Kaz searches for two missing children for a sizeable reward, only to discover the First Order is also hunting for them.
When out on a routine training exercise, a distress signal sends Kaz and Poe to a damaged ship with strange life-forms onboard.
On a mission to repair a vital platform defense, Kaz befriends the mysterious Synara and comes under attack by pirates.
An upcoming race reunites Yeager with his estranged brother, Marcus, who needs to win to pay off his debt to a criminal organization.
Poe Dameron recruits young pilot Kazuda Xiono to become a spy for the Resistance to keep tabs on the growing threat of the First Order.

Neeku adopts a strange sea creature and gets way more than he bargained for when it brings chaos to the platform.
In exchange for parts, Kaz minds acquisitions for Flix and Orka and comes into conflict with a shady alien customer in league with the First Order.

Kaz scrambles to help Synara escape the platform as the First Order sends a contingent of stormtroopers to hunt a spy.

Stories from across the world and refreshing conversations with Audie Cornish.
Missouri police are thrust into a bizarre web of homeless drifters and cattle auctions when they are called to retrieve a dead body.

A killer wants to outwit the police and keep the identity of his victim secret so he removes the teeth; however, lab tests on the skull reveal not just the horrific nature of the murder, but the identity of the victim too.
When a fundamentalist group is accused of robbing banks, authorities know they are dealing with experienced criminals and overwhelming evidence, but the defense is very well-funded.

When a young doctor is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting two of his female patients, DNA tests show him to be innocent, but the women persist with their claims; seven years later, a private investigation leads to a surprising discovery.
The search for the killer of two teenagers in Texas shows a behavioral study on how most serial killers also have a history of abusing animals.
When a farmer's wife disappears, the tests of a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist lead to a surprising revelation.
A son who is convinced of his mother's innocence in the death of his father enrolls in law school to try and clear her name.
A tiny clue inside a suspect's watchband and a popular television show help solve the case of a woman's disappearance.

The pornography empire cultivated by brothers Artie and Jim Mitchell crumbles when one turns up dead and his brother confesses to shooting him; investigators question whether the shooting was premeditated.

When a 9-year-old girl vanishes on her way to school, the entire community helps with the search; detectives believe her mother may be involved, and a hidden fingerprint seals the case.
The investigation of a murder case in New Jersey is stalled until a similar attack occurs on a state trooper in Maine.
A young woman goes missing without leaving many clues, but the advanced technology on offer makes it possible for cat hairs and insects to help build an image of the abductor.
Blood spatter analysis and an investigation lead police to the truth when a pregnant woman is found dead in her home.
A mother is determined to discover what happened when her daughter is injured in a hit-and-run accident.
Forensic science and deductive reasoning determine what happened to a mother and daughter while they were on a shopping spree.
When three students are brutally murdered close to campus, investigators must determine what the women had in common before their serial killer strikes again.
A bag full of evidence recovered from an iced-over river helps to reveal the murderer of a businesswoman in her own shop.
Eyewitness to real estate agent's murder is put under forensic hypnosis in an attempt to help him recall the killer's face.
Police launch a search for a killer after a teenager returns home to find his father's body in a pool of blood.
Pathologist examining the death of a politician who was running for re-election finds tiny puncture wounds at the autopsy.

A Naval officer who threatened to go public with tales of on-the-job sexual harassment and assault is brutally murdered, but when investigators find the allegations could be part of an elaborate scheme for money, they turn to forensic science.
A man is found stabbed to death after a night in a strip club; a drop of blood on a bedspread becomes critical evidence five years later.
After police identify a murder victim thanks to her butterfly necklace, they discover several co-workers had vendettas against the victim.
The brutal murder of a construction site foreman looks like the work of a disgruntled employee, but forensic science points to an unlikely suspect.

A shooting victim mutters the name of her apparent assailant before dying, but fingerprint comparisons, handwriting analysis, ballistics and DNA testing show someone else close to home is the true killer.
A woman's story seemed far-fetched; she tells investigators that a man broke into her home wearing only underwear and gloves, killed her boyfriend and raped and terrorized her.
After a Delaware man's mother is found dead, he tells a story that's so improbable police think it can't possibly be true.
A family vacation turns into a terrifying search for a missing wife and baby, then becomes a manhunt for a killer who committed a horrific crime.
A DNA dragnet catches a killer eight years after the kidnapping, rape and murder of a college coed in Oklahoma.
Detectives think they've solved a murder when they find the weapon and victim's blood in a man's flat, but the evidence may have been planted.
Detectives search for the bombers of two churches in Illinois, hoping that the materials used in the remnants of the handmade bombs will offer the clues to catch the culprits.

There was no apparent reason for the young, healthy college student to be dead; but when the medical examiner found the tiniest of clues during the autopsy, investigators were able to unravel the mystery of betrayal and revenge.
A woman is stabbed a hundred times and her body positioned in a suggestive manner. This could be a hate crime against women.
Police are able to create a composite sketch of a man burnt beyond recognition. But tracking the killer is more challenging.
By cutting a strand of a murdered man's hair into sections, forensics reveal a record of his last six months alive, and find he was frequently ingesting huge amounts of arsenic.
A bullet-riddled car, a missing driver, and no witnesses, an ambush or a random attack; the clue was something so tiny, it was measured in millionths of a meter.
Teenager is found half-naked with her throat slit; a single foreign hair found on her thumb may finger the killer.

Two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered; the similarities of the crime scenes led police to believe they were dealing with a serial killer who hated women, and they had to find him before he struck again.
Weeks after a student vanishes, the body of an unknown female is found in the ashes of a fire 700 miles away; an alert policeman realizes the crimes could be connected.
Investigators face a growing list of suspects after a beautiful flight attendant is brutally murdered in her own home.

The assistant manager of the restaurant had been stabbed to death; police knew why he'd been killed: $8,000 was missing from the safe. As to who was responsible, his family and friends couldn't even imagine who'd want to hurt him.
Florida authorities rely on DNA evidence to try to nail the killer of a woman who was abducted from her late-night job at a convenience store, raped and strangled.
A wild fire in a secluded parking lot leads police to discover a dreadful homicide, with the suspect's image caught by security cameras.

Eight years after a man confessed to the murder of a young woman, another man claims that he committed the crime, and investigators must use forensic evidence to determine the true killer.
Although a group of teenage thugs are suspected of attacking two boys on a fishing trip, there is no solid evidence until a murky fishing hole provides some answers.

When young prostitute's body turns up in an Ohio waterway, authorities have one tiny clue which could point to her killer, but face huge challenges due to her policemen clients and DNA evidence being washed away.

In a small South Carolina town in 1991, 17-year-old Crystal Faye Todd, a popular high school student, is raped, murdered and dumped in a deserted field; with few leads, authorities test the DNA of several friends, and one match shocks everyone.
In a groundbreaking case using animal DNA, investigators use forensic testing on a cat to help them solve the case of a woman who vanished from her home on Prince Edward Island.
A look into the 1984 Oregon food poisonings, where detectives track down the outbreak to a cult which aims to use germ warfare to take down the government.
A woman is found dead from a gunshot wound and police suspect her husband, however, forensic teams prove what really happened, and the truth is stranger than fiction.
After American Atheists founder Madalyn Murray O'Hair disappears, the discovery of a mutilated body helps police catch the culprit.
Two people witness a truck driving over an unconscious man and flee into a nearby bar, but when the police turn up, the truck, the man and the witnesses are gone.
Insect evidence helps to solve the mystery of a woman found dead near a river bank.
A girl who is abducted and then released soon afterward uses her knowledge of forensics to lead police to the kidnapper.

A trash collector finds a severed human leg in a trash bin, but police cannot use conventional methods of victim identification; investigators turn to toxicology and DNA tests to find the murder-mutilator.
A coroner finds telltale clues on the badly burned body of a murder victim, sending police in pursuit of a couple of killers.
A nosy neighbor with a disturbing obsession becomes a suspect in a woman's murder at an upscale apartment complex; police discover an incredible link to an unrelated murder thousands of miles away.
A college student turns up dead, and her boyfriend becomes a prime suspect when blood splatters are discovered on his wall.
Texas police hunt frantically for a brutal rapist. No one knows where he'll strike next, but given the increasingly violent nature of his crimes, he must be found soon.
When detectives find a mismatched button in relation to a woman's death, they know they can follow the clue back to the killer.
A woman heads home after church, but never makes it there alive, triggering a homicide investigation.
Volunteers and police spend weeks searching for a missing girl. A psychic later leads them to a field where the body was found.
Forensic investigators try to stop a killer who is apparently responsible for two slayings in a community in South Carolina.
When DNA proves that a man who practically admits to a brutal attack is innocent, police wonder why he is willing to take the blame.
When a businessman is murdered, motives and suspects are plentiful. Was it simply a disgruntled employee or client? Or do some racy photos hold the clue to the crime?
A family break turns into a nightmare when the wife is found face-down in a lake; with no idea whether it was murder, an accident or suicide, police turn to a new forensic technique.

When friends see a woman in the back of a car flailing her arms and screaming, they assume she is having fun, but when they later come upon a jacket and a pool of blood, they realize they witnessed an abduction in progress.
An attack on a couple's home leaves the husband dead, the wife gravely injured and their son as a prime suspect; hundreds of miles away, a DNA sample may lead to the killer.
Detectives think they've solved a murder when they find the weapon and victim's blood in a man's flat, but the evidence may have been planted.

After a prominent Arizona surgeon is found stabbed to death outside his office, investigators uncover an unlikely suspect with deep pockets and an even deeper hatred for the doctor.
Police don't have a basis for comparison to match shoe impressions, blood drops and DNA evidence from a murder scene.
A masked gunman kills two members of a family and wounds two others after they interrupt his burglary at their upscale suburban home.
A killer leaves equally incriminating evidence at the scene when he meticulously wipes away his fingerprint and shoe impressions.
After a woman is found dead at a yacht club in California in an apparent case of love gone wrong, investigators discover her home life was as dramatic as films made in nearby Hollywood.
The brutal murder of a state park employee over $2,000 rattles her co-workers and tourists while leaving police to sift through hundreds of leads.
When evidence shows a woman's rape and murder, police must find the killer as well as the victim.
A week after a couple disappears from the beach, police get a mysterious lead from a robbery.
Fifteen years later, DNA technology leads to justice for a murdered woman and her savagely beaten 4-year-old daughter.
A quiet waitress who hasn't been to work in two days vanishes without a trace; police suspect a date gone wrong.

The search for a missing exotic dancer led police to an isolated 75-acre site where someone had been shot and cremated, thus destroying all evidence... almost; piece of a foot provided enough DNA for a genetic profile and positive ID.
After years of suffering domestic abuse, a young woman is found murdered in her bathtub; among numerous clues, a hamburger bun proves the most incriminating.
Evidence that includes threatening emails, a missing person and an abandoned truck lead police to a woman's suspected killer, but they don't have the victim's body.
A woman has an accidental fall down a flight of stairs and appears to have hit her head, but the lack of blood splatter and misplaced shoes lead police to believe the fall was staged.

The murder of a young Seattle couple puzzles investigators until the victims' dog, Chief, leads police to the killer.
A handsome young doctor's fiancée experiences severe illness after revealing that she is pregnant, and launches her own investigation to determine if the doctor is somehow responsible.
A seemingly model citizen turns out to be a serial killer.
An abandoned, still-running car leads investigators to a body with unusual marks and a DNA trail that lead to the killer.
Police find fragments of deleted computer files leading them to suspect a woman's suicide is really murder.

A family suspects their teenage daughter's new friends were involved in her disappearance.

When a 6-year-old disappears, her father becomes the prime suspect; he fails a polygraph test and even confesses, but 10 years later, the investigation gets turned on its head.
Investigators build a makeshift tent around a woman's body and use superglue fumes to lift the killer's palm print from the victim's skin.
The disappearance of a mail-order bride proves suspicious when detectives learn that two of the Texas husband's previous wives had died in mysterious circumstances.

When a man perishes in a fire while working in his garage, his death is initially ruled an accident until a forensic odontologist changes the direction of the case.
Lack of evidence compels investigators to look beyond the obvious when a woman is beaten to death at her in-laws house.
A man is found dead of an apparent suicide. But soon after, information emerges which reveals a much more menacing scenario.
A dismembered body is dumped on the side of the New Jersey Turnpike and before police realize it, bodies are turning up between two states.
A young bride-to-be is gunned down in her own home. The attack is personal and as investigators start digging, they uncover the man she loved was living a lie.
Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant, and it is unknown if she ran away or if she was the victim of foul play.

An Ohio woman and her two daughters go missing while vacationing in Florida; their corpses are found floating in Tampa Bay with a handwritten note by one of the victims; putting it on five billboards helps them find the killer.
Four young adults are murdered in an affluent Texas neighborhood, with little evidence but two people walking by dressed in black.
A young college student is found dead in her apartment and the autopsy rules the death a homicide by an unknown male suspect.
The killer removed the computer that links him to the murder of a woman and her soon-to-be ex-husband that he had met online.
A community is shocked when police discover a woman raped and murdered in broad daylight on a public trail.
A real estate developer is shot and his wife becomes the prime suspect, until the bullet is linked to a weapon reported missing 20 years ago.
A body is found stuffed into a suitcase forcing the police to search though the landfill for another missing victim.

Los Angeles police detectives crush a guns-to-gangs operation with a wild woman from internal affairs.
Los Angeles police partners take on members of a Chinese triad who are smuggling families from the mainland.

Frank must make amends with his granddaughter, Ally, when she catches him stealing food at the supermarket.
Raymond learns that a local sports radio broadcaster dislikes him after Ray offers to be on his show.
Robert proposes to Amy; Ray meets Amy's ultraconservative parents.
Debra convinces Ray to take his turn at disciplining the twins.
Ray enjoys his volunteer work at the hospital because the patients treat him like a celebrity; Debra comes to regret her decision to force her husband to volunteer at the hospital.
Ray persuades Robert to botch an invitation assignment so Amy will let him off the hook with their wedding plans, but the scheme backfires.
When Ray drops off Ally for a sleepover, he gets the idea that his nemesis in the cookie drive is making a pass at him.
Debra chooses a friend to replace her if she dies but gets annoyed when Ray seems pleased by the idea.
Marie attempts to take over when Debra throws a bridal shower for Amy; Debra runs into trouble with the law and must rely on Marie for help.

Robert asks Ray if he can borrow a suitcase sitting on the stairway for his honeymoon; Ray explains he and Debra have been in an unspoken battle of wills since a weekend trip over who is responsible for putting the case away.
Debra and Marie give Raymond a guilt trip when they find out that the bachelor party he hosted for Robert was a huge disappointment.

Tightly wound Debra decides to join Ray on a golf outing in order to recover their former fun-loving relationship.
Michael claims he's too sick to go to school and spends an entire day watching Ray work in his downstairs office.
Ray's contractor friend takes an eternity to replace the kitchen stove.
When Amy invites her brother to stay for dinner, he makes himself comfortable on the couch and never leaves.
Debra's mother enlists an unwilling Ray to help plan a surprise birthday party for his wife.
The Barones spend a discomfiting Thanksgiving Day at Amy's parents' house.

An important job offer in New York forces Christine to choose between her career and Hayden.
Christine's network premiere party is scheduled the same night as Hayden's sports banquet.
The stress of a long-distance relationship troubles Hayden; Luther and Dauber refinish Hayden's game-room floor.
Hayden wins his first football game of the year and proposes to Christine on his new live television show.
Dauber's relationship with his girlfriend, Judy, is threatened when he becomes a Big Brother to an 8-year-old.
Hayden hires Kelly's roommate to act as his daughter when Kelly refuses to attend his Father of the Year banquet.
Luther complains to Hayden about the lack of recognition for his contribution to the team's success.
Howard's wife, Shirley (Georgia Engel), comes to work in the athletic department and drives him crazy.
Fred buys a racehorse with an impressive history in hopes of breeding him.
Fred's niece, the spitting image of his late wife, visits the Sanford home.
Julio's sister and nephew stay with the Sanfords temporarily.
A fun time is had by all when Grady serves his friends, including two policemen, a salad made with marijuana.
Fred tries to sculpt a work of art from junk when he discovers the value of sculpture.
Grady must decide whether to lie when he receives too many Social Security checks.

Jack and Furley become trapped in a freezer at Angelino's restaurant.
Jack's old flame asks him for marital advice.
Jack feigns amnesia after wrecking Janet's car.
Jack checks into a hospital to have an embarrassing tattoo removed.

Ray catches Debra poking fun at him in front of the children, then realizes his mother did the same thing when he was a youngster.
Debra assures her husband she will be on time for an awards dinner, then her hair gets caught in a curling iron.
Ray refuses to buy a $250 dress for Ally to wear to her friend's birthday party.
Amy and Marie debate whether Robert should retire from the police force early.
Ray receives an honorary doctorate and forgets to mention Debra in his acceptance speech.
Robert becomes defensive when Amy's parents point out his habit of touching food to his chin before eating it; Amy devises a plan to break Robert of his strange habit.

Ray gets upset when he learns that Debra has been sharing their intimate secrets with her friends.

Ray's lie causes Debra to make a fashion statement to the members of the PTA.

Grady feels out of place when he moves in with his daughter and her family.

Most high school romances end in heartbreak; however, Richard and Jolena rekindle their romance years later even though one of them is already married, and someone in this love triangle will wind up dead.
Charlene attracts more than one man with her beauty and one by one they all go crazy vying for her love; love may be heavenly, but for some it can be hell.

Young and in love, Stephanie and Daniel are happily balancing work and play; before long, tensions arise due to disappointment, self-loathing and a mutual affection for the bottle, and, by the final curtain call, only one of them is left standing.
After Gary and Pam Triano's marriage comes to an end, shady business deals, a series of betrayals and an extremely bitter custody battle lead to a climax that is nothing short of explosive.

Atlanta preschool teacher Julie Love goes missing just a week after getting engaged to boyfriend Mark; detectives find numerous suspects in the teacher's disappearance, but the truth turns out to be far worse than they could have imagined.

Film director Adrienne Shelly is discovered hanging by a bedsheet from the shower rod in her bathroom; while Shelly's death looks like a suicide, her husband insists it was murder, and detectives start to believe him.
After New York City fashion photographer Joel Schoenfeld is shot dead in his Greenwich Village studio, detectives uncover a dark secret and a twisted tale of revenge.
Crime experts explore the motives and modus operandi of female killers; while males are often driven by anger, impulse and destruction, women usually have more complex, long-term reasons to kill.
Eyes are the windows to the soul, except for these three demented women.
Three women who are devoid of a moral compass believe they can outsmart everyone.
When the entrepreneurial spirit turns two best friends into mortal enemies, one woman goes on the run.
When a workplace affair leads to a dead body in the woods, investigators expose lies that will reveal a killer.

In Grand Prairie, Texas, a game of truth-or-dare leads to a startling confession in the 1995 shooting death of 16-year-old Adrianne Jones.
A wife is killed while calling 911 and her husband is shot in the leg; he claims it was an intruder, but the police have their doubts.

A wife wakes to find her husband dead outside in the snow, she calls 911; when the police discover a volatile history, suspicions are aroused; a man calls police after both his parents are shot dead in their home.

A mother brutally murdered in her home, the husband and his bizarre alter ego are in the frame after calling 911; a woman is found dead in a creek after a road accident, her husband calls 911 in a panic.
As cameras follow the work of Grand Rapids patrol officers, Deputy Chief Joe Trigg must navigate the chaos of a high-stakes series of shootings, high-speed chases and standoffs.

After the murder of 15-year-old Milli Penn, Grand Rapids detectives investigate the masked shooter, rumored to be another teenager linked to a fight club; then, another shooting strikes and detectives must solve the case before more lives are lost.

What seemed like an accidental overdose becomes a murder investigation when a jail informant tips off Grand Rapids detectives; conflicting witness accounts leave the detectives searching for hard evidence to solve Dana's death.
Detectives are determined to find Anthony Edwards' killer when the 46-year-old man is found shot in a park.

Shelby Weatherly is found stabbed to death by the side of the highway, and investigators struggle to find a suspect; forensic evidence and reports of a mysterious car lead to revealing images and evidence that point toward the vicious killer.
Bodycam video captures the hunt for a madman who unleashed a six-person killing spree upon the Scottsdale, Ariz., area over the course of 96 hours.

When 27-year-old Byron Edwards is found brutally stabbed in his home, his family is absolutely devastated. But as detectives work to find the person responsible, they discover a single piece of evidence that changes the course of their investigation.

In Oklahoma, officers negotiate with a delusional father who is armed and dangerous; in Florida, officers chase a joyrider who is set on evading capture; in Arizona, state troopers rescue a driver trapped in torrential waters.

The playoff run includes a first-round series win over the Kings. A hard fought Western Conference Finals between the Lakers and Blazers comes down to an incredible 4th quarter in Game 7, with the Lakers down 15 and on the brink of elimination.

After completing one of the greatest fourth quarter comebacks in NBA history, the Lakers prevail in the NBA Finals over the Indiana Pacers in six games, with a monumental celebration outside STAPLES Center.
